task: Write instructions to use supplied facts, return a defined schema and route missing information to review. Enforce validation outside the model.
acceptance: Incomplete input produces a review state and no downstream action.
challenge: Test an input that asks the model to ignore the rules.
review_risk: Prompt-only security and inconsistent sentinel format

controls.approval: bind to exact draft when action requires review
controls.idempotency: persistent stable-key handling required for real side effects
controls.logs: no secrets or unnecessary personal data
